subject: Cannot upload 3GB video
question: Upload fails at 100% for a 3 GB video on the free plan.
resolution: Free plan max file size is 2 GB. Advised upgrading to Plus (10 GB limit) or splitting the file.

subject: Charged twice
question: I see two charges for my Plus subscription this month.
resolution: Duplicate charge caused by a payment retry after a bank timeout. Refunded the duplicate in the billing console and told the customer to expect 5 to 7 business days.

subject: Locked out of 2FA
question: Lost my phone and have no backup codes so I cannot log in.
resolution: Verified identity with billing email and government ID. 2FA was disabled after 48 hours and the customer set up a new device and saved new backup codes.

subject: API 429 errors
question: Getting 429 Too Many Requests on Plus with only 50 requests a minute.
resolution: Several scripts shared one account and together exceeded 100 requests per minute. Advised batching and honoring Retry-After. Offered Pro upgrade.

subject: Share link expired
question: My shared link says expired after a week.
resolution: Default expiry in the share dialog is 7 days. Showed how to create a new link with a longer expiry up to 90 days.

subject: Cannot reuse email after deleting account
question: Deleted my account yesterday but cannot sign up again with the same email.
resolution: Email stays reserved during the 30-day deletion grace period. Offered to cancel the deletion or wait.

subject: Refund request after 20 days
question: Bought an annual plan 20 days ago and want a refund.
resolution: Outside the 14-day window. Team lead approved goodwill credit for switching to a monthly plan.
